text: Create coherent pixel-art status assets for the queue UI. Preserve the existing vector Start control. Status cells are 16 by 16 logical pixels. Working uses four horizontal frames with a 100 ms frame duration. Ready and Retry are static images. Use transparent backgrounds, readable silhouettes and the existing UI's cool blue accent; a fixed palette is not required. Inspect at 1x and 3x nearest display scale on the actual dark panel. The working loop must communicate activity without looking like success. Error/retry must be distinguishable without color alone.
